calculation.description: At each date, standardize each asset's five-session return relative to the cross-sectional median and reverse the signal only when five-day cross-sectional dispersion is above its trailing 60-session median. The signal uses information through the prior completed date only in live use.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark daily IC and ICIR gates on 15 tradable cross-asset instruments. Strong in 2020-2024 but ineffective in 2025-2027; use conditional sizing and revalidate promptly. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty.
